family_policy: Group shared core claims, direct variants and shared positive evidence. Broad topic overlap alone does not make all sleep research one family. This is held-out queries, not held-out publications or populations.

scoring.unit_deduplication: maximum window score; stable unit ID tie break
scoring.tuning_grid: singleton fixed settings; no holdout-driven changes

claim_policy: Only literal original-bound source text with role and qualifiers; no cosine entailment. Arbitrary paraphrases and clinical/excluded requests abstain.
recall_denominator: Each supported/partial case averages recall of its provisional referenced units; unsupported cases excluded from recall, evaluated for abstention.
benefit_gate: holdout macro recall@3 strictly greater, recall@5 no lower; otherwise no demonstrated benefit
independent_review: pending for all40; labels are provisional technical expectations
